classification_vocabulary.rule: terminal_outcome = the generation reached a decision; attention_lost = the generation was abandoned by expiry or staleness (never implies completion); active = still in flight. `closed` is its own terminal_outcome member and is never folded into `completed` (R-F6).

source.census: select plan_id, role, status, count(*) from vision.tickets group by 1,2,3
source.bucket_query: WITH b AS ( SELECT t.plan_id, t.role, t.status, count(*)::int AS row_count, array_agg(t.id) AS ids FROM vision.tickets t GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ) SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'plan_id', b.plan_id, 'role', b.role, 'status', b.status, 'count', b.row_count, 'transition_events', ( SELECT count(*)::int FROM kernel.transition_event e WHERE e.aggregate_type = 'ticket' AND e.aggregate_id = ANY(b.ids)), 'expiry_detection_events', ( SELECT count(*)::int FROM kernel.transition_event e WHERE e.aggregate_type = 'ticket' AND e.aggregate_id = ANY(b.ids) AND e.payload->>'reason' = 'expiry_detection') ) ORDER BY b.plan_id, b.role, b.status), '[]'::jsonb) FROM b
source.event_join: kernel.transition_event.aggregate_id = vision.tickets.id (aggregate_type='ticket'); payload carries no ticket_id
